outline.rationale: The user is a complete neural-net beginner whose goal is reading comprehension of papers/blogs, so the outline front-loads foundational concepts (neural nets, embeddings, tokens) that a more advanced user would skip. Attention gets its own dedicated node since it's the central Transformer concept and the most-referenced term. The Transformer block node assembles the pieces, and encoder/decoder addresses a vocabulary distinction that constantly appears in papers. The 'why they beat predecessors' node gives context that helps interpret motivation sections of papers without going into RNN/LSTM internals. The final vocabulary node directly serves the stated reading goal. I excluded coding, training mechanics, optimization, and math derivations per the confirmed understanding. Nodes are MECE: each answers a distinct question with low overlap.
